name: Telegram
summary: Talk to your agent through a Telegram bot.
description: Connects a Telegram bot you made with @BotFather to Girru. Messages from the people you allow reach your primary agent, which can answer them when you turn on automatic replies; your agents can also send messages through the bot. Girru keeps the connection (long polling, no public address needed), the list of allowed senders and the message log. Text only.
permissions: Connects to Telegram with the bot token you save, and stays connected while it is on
Lets only the sender IDs you list reach your agent; an empty list lets no one in
Answers with your primary agent only when you turn on automatic replies, and that agent gets a restricted set of tools
Keeps the messages in Girru's channel log, and the tables older Girru versions made for it
Adds a telegram_send tool that agents can use once you allow them
